## Summary

I implemented the audit-on-create requirement for `POST /api/owners`.

**New function class** — `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`: takes the created `Owner` via `@Val` and emits an audit line through the SLF4J logger named `AUDIT`, including the owner id, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate`.

**Wiring** — `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`: inserted an `audit` step between `save` and `respond`. Placing it after `SaveOwner` guarantees the owner id has been assigned, and `customerCode` (set by `AssignCustomerCode`) and `registrationDate` (set by `BuildOwner`) are already populated. It carries `govern: [ transaction ]` to match the surrounding write steps.

The AUDIT logger line observed in the run — `Owner created id=11 customerCode=TOW-SUR-0001 registrationDate=2026-09-07` — contains all three required values, and `AcceptanceTest` (which captures the `AUDIT` logger and asserts a single line contains the id, customerCode, and registrationDate read back from the API) passes. `BUILD SUCCESS`, 1/1 tests green.
